title: ‘Twilight’ Saga Sparkles Again With Alex and Ani’s New Vampire-Inspired Jewelry Line
summary: Team Edward, Team Jacob or simply Team Twilight? Fans can relive the vampire romance that defined a generation with Alex and Ani’s new jewelry line.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Twilight fans, this is the moment you’ve been waiting for. Alex and Ani has launched a new jewelry collection inspired by Stephenie Meyer’s bestselling vampire romance saga , giving “Twihards” a new way to celebrate the love story that captivated millions.

Hold on tight, spider monkeys: The collection features bracelets, rings and necklaces filled with subtle Easter eggs inspired by Bella Swan, Edward Cullen, Jacob Black and the unforgettable world of Forks, Washington. Fans can shop or preorder pieces inspired by some of the saga’s most memorable moments, including Bella’s engagement ring , character-inspired lockets and the fan-favorite “Hoa Hoa” bracelets that pay tribute to the series’ unforgettable details.

HOLD ON TIGHT

The Twilight Saga Spider Monkey Locket Necklace

$58

Buy Now at Alex and Ani

16-inch chain with a two-inch extender, available in gold or silver finishes.

Turn a favorite Twilight memory into a keepsake with this Spider Monkey Locket Necklace. Featuring a hidden enamel charm of Bella and Edward’s iconic scene, the necklace celebrates the couple’s unforgettable romance with the quote, “You better hold on tight spider monkey” and a “Bella + Edward” engraving.

FAN-FAVORITE FIND

The Twilight Saga Bella & Edward Charm Bangle

$38

Match your spider monkey locket with a charm bangle available in gold and silver finishes.

From Bella and Edward’s unforgettable bond to the forests that shaped their story, this Twilight Charm Bangle captures the details fans love most. The expandable wire design includes an enamel couple charm, a crystal heart and a tree charm inspired by the beloved saga’s Pacific Northwest setting.

BELLA & EDWARD FOREVER

The Twilight Saga Bella & Edward Locket Cuff

$54

Made from a nickel-free material.

The romance at the heart of Twilight gets a wearable tribute with this Bella and Edward Locket Cuff. Designed with a hidden opening, the piece reveals the couple’s meadow scene and the quote that defined their relationship, “And so the lion fell in love with the lamb,” finished with a “Bella + Edward” engraving.

SELLING FAST

The Twilight Saga Edward Lariat Necklace

Adjustable 17- to 20-inch chain with a two-inch extender.

Celebrate the vampire who captured Bella Swan’s heart with this Edward Lariat Necklace. The silver design showcases memorable details from the movie, including a “Team Edward” charm, Cullen Crest and Edward Cullen portrait. The adjustable chain measures 17 to 20 inches with a two-inch extender for a personalized fit.

HOA HOA SEASON

The Twilight Saga Hoa Hoa Tension Bangle

Preorder the bangle now, arriving Aug. 20.

The viral “Hoa Hoa Hoa” moment gets a jewelry-inspired update with this Twilight Tension Bangle. Crafted in a silver finish, the bracelet is engraved with the fan-favorite phrase and accented with pavé crystals and pine tree details that nods to the atmosphere of Forks.

PREORDER NOW

The Twilight Saga Bella's Engagement Ring

$44

After selling out in minutes, this fan-favorite is now available for preorder ahead of its Aug. 20 restock.

Relive one of Twilight ‘s most unforgettable moments with this Bella-inspired engagement ring. The size seven silver locket ring opens to reveal Bella and Edward’s wedding day and is engraved with “Let’s start with forever” inside and “Bella + Edward” on the back, making it a meaningful keepsake for longtime fans.

TEAM JACOB

The Twilight Saga Jacob Pendant Necklace

A subtle tribute to Team Jacob, crafted in gold and silver finishes.

Still rooting for Team Jacob? This layered necklace pays tribute to Bella’s werewolf best friend with thoughtful Twilight -inspired details. The necklace combines an “I <3 Jacob” charm strand with a dog tag engraved with Jacob’s “loca” quote, plus wolf and feather charms inspired by his character.

Designed for longtime fans and new readers alike, the Alex and Ani x Twilight collection transforms the franchise’s most beloved symbols into wearable keepsakes. Whether you’re Team Edward, Team Jacob or simply can’t quit the Twilight obsession, this jewelry collection is made for fans keeping the saga alive.

Shop Alex and Ani 'Twilight' Saga Collection

Announced on Friday, July 17, the collection arrives as Twilight ’s fandom continues to thrive, with the franchise remaining one of the most recognizable pop culture phenomena of the 2000s. Music even helped shape the world of Twilight , according to author Stephenie Meyer, who shared an unofficial playlist featuring artists such as Travis, Radiohead, Coldplay, My Chemical Romance and Muse.

Some pieces from the collection have already begun selling out, while other designs are available for preorder, proving that nearly two decades later, fans are still enchanted by Bella, Edward and Jacob’s story.
